## Open-Source AI Agents

- `2026-11-12` — The Example Foundation published version 1.1 of its shared trace format for agent runs.
  [examplefoundation.org — Trace format 1.1](https://examplefoundation.org/news/trace-format-1-1)
  > Version 1.1 of the vendor-neutral trace format adds cost and token fields to every model-call event.
  >
  > Each event now carries input, output and cached token counts, so a replayed run shows where its spend went step by step.
  >
  > Six agent frameworks emit the format today, up from four at the 1.0 release in September, the announcement says.

- `2026-11-18` — Northwind Labs released version 3 of its agent runtime with per-tool spending limits.
  [northwind.example — Agent runtime 3.0](https://northwind.example/blog/runtime-3)
  ![source image](https://northwind.example/img/runtime-3.png)
  > Northwind Labs shipped version 3 of its open-source agent runtime, adding a spending limit to every tool.
  >
  > A tool's manifest now declares a maximum cost per call, and the runtime stops a run that would cross the limit instead of finishing it.
  >
  > The release notes say 9 of the 14 built-in tools ship with default limits, and the rest are marked free.
